title: Bulleogi
description: Adds an item in Minecraft that allows you to place blocks that exist only as blocks.
body:
###  [Supported Languages: Korean, English, Japanese, and Vietnamese]
Adds an item in Minecraft that allows you to place blocks that exist only as blocks.
Adds items for blocks that normally don't have them, including: 
- Frosted Ice
- Bubble Columns and Water (Up/Down)
- Air
- Nether Portal
- End Portal
- End Gateway

Added blocks
- Bubble Columns (Up/Down) **Fabric only!!!**
- debug
- debug2

💡 How to find:
You can find all the added items in the **Loaded Blocks** and **Added Blocks** category of the Creative Inventory!
